pairs.subject: cost-metering
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/observability/PerformanceView.tsx:51 The observability spend view plots total daily cost without isolating failed-call spend into its own series or providing row-level drill-down to underlying ledger rows, folding failure waste invisibly into aggregate spend.

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/observability/PerformanceView.tsx:51 The daily spend chart folds failed-call spend into aggregate cost rather than tracking money spent on failed calls as its own series, and provides no row-level drill-down.

src/components/dashboard/views/observability/performance-view/PerformanceSpendCard.tsx:42 Per-agent spend card maps only known personas and omits an unattributed spend bucket, hiding unattributed spend.

src/components/dashboard/views/observability/PerformanceView.tsx:74 Budget checks are advisory client-side threshold comparisons (BUDGET_THRESHOLD = 0.8) displaying an alert banner rather than gating call paths.

src/components/dashboard/views/observability/activity-view/useActivityMetrics.ts:28 Activity metrics spend summary is only fetched from demo-only mock data via useDemoOnlySWR with no synced durable usage ledger behind it in production.

pairs.registryProposal: spend-observability should clarify whether consumer dashboards consuming pre-aggregated daily metrics are expected to synthesize failure spend breakdowns or if upstream aggregation schemas must explicitly provide them.

declined.subject: cost-metering
declined.reason: Precondition does not hold: authentication and user session files handle user authentication, OAuth callbacks, and cache invalidation, with no code paths for token metering, price tables, or budget enforcement.
